When calling the API with a token generated by `gcloud auth application-default`, pass two headers in your request:

- `x-goog-user-project`: The ID of your Google Cloud project that has `notebook.googleapis.com` enabled (used as the quota project for the request).

records.summary: Grain provides a broad REST API for recordings, transcripts, uploads, clips, stories, playlists, hooks, and workspace metadata, plus an official remote MCP server. Personal API access is available on Free, while workspace-wide access is paid and admin-gated.
records.blocker: Workspace Access Tokens require Business or Enterprise and admin generation; workspace-scope OAuth clients must be verified by Grain. The MCP server accepts personal-scope tokens only, and some MCP tools require Business or Enterprise. The current API version is 2026-10-01, not the deprecated 2025-10-31.
records.next_action: For a personal integration, generate a PAT on Free or use personal-scope OAuth and send Public-Api-Version: 2026-10-01. For workspace-wide access, use a Business or Enterprise admin to generate a WAT, but keep MCP on a separate personal-scope token.
